in_marathi.name: Udarika
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Udar + Ika Strength + Feminine Form
in_marathi.long_meaning: Udarika हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Udarika is a name derived from the Sanskrit word 'Udar'. The prefix 'Ika' is the feminine form of the Sanskrit word 'Ika'. Udar means 'strength' or 'power'. This name is often used to signify a strong and powerful woman in Hindu culture and mythology.
